title: A Study to Assess The Safety and Tolerability of Pumitamig-Based Therapy Administered Before Surgery in Participants With Early-Stage Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer (ROSETTA Lung-220)
official: ROSETTA Lung-220: A Phase 2, Open-Label, Multicenter, Multi-Arm Platform Study Evaluating Pumitamig and Other Novel Neoadjuvant Regimens in Participants With Resectable, Early-Stage (IIA to IIIB) Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer
summary: The purpose of this study is to assess the safety, tolerability, and surgical feasibility of preoperative Pumitamig-based therapy and other molecules in resectable, Early-Stage Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria

* Participants must have newly diagnosed, previously untreated participants with histologically confirmed non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) (squamous or non-squamous histology); resectable Stage IIA to IIIB (N2) disease (American Joint Committee on Cancer (AJCC) 9th edition).
* Participants must have an Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status score of 0 or 1.
* Participants must have an evaluable programmed death-ligand 1 (PD-L1) expression.

Exclusion Criteria

* Participants must not have unresectable disease, N3 nodal involvement, or any evidence of distant metastatic disease (M1) at baseline assessment (suspected or confirmed).
* Participants must not have active, known autoimmune disease.
* Participants must not have significant cardiovascular impairment as evidenced by uncontrolled hypertension (despite optimal medical treatment), congestive heart failure, active coronary disease (within 6 months prior to randomization), ventricular arrhythmias or major thrombotic or embolic events.
* Participants must not have advanced/clinically significant lung disease (within 6 months prior to randomization) or history of interstitial lung disease (ILD) or pneumonitis requiring treatment with systemic steroids (≥ Grade 2), or who have current or suspected ILD or pneumonitis.
* Participants must not have significant risk of bleeding or history of major hemorrhagic events (including gastrointestinal (GI) hemorrhage or hemorrhagic stroke).
* Participants must not have GI or non-GI fistula, GI perforation, or intra-abdominal abscess.
* Participants must not have prior systemic anticancer therapy, radiotherapy, or investigational therapy for NSCLC or contraindication to curative-intent surgery or study-specified chemotherapy.
* Other protocol-defined Inclusion/Exclusion criteria apply.
